plan.goal: Dose APAP at 0.5 mM working concentration from a 500 mM DMSO stock and verify the DMSO volume fraction stays under the solvent-toxicity guideline.
plan.rationale: APAP (acetaminophen) working concentration of 0.5 mM prepared by dilution from a 500 mM DMSO stock. The DMSO fraction is computed as stock/working ratio = 0.5/500 = 0.1% v/v, which is 5× below the ~0.5% v/v solvent-toxicity onset and at the ≤0.1% recommended ceiling for primary cells. A vehicle-only control (0.1% DMSO, no APAP) is required to subtract solvent effects.
caveats: Include a vehicle-only control (0.1% DMSO in medium, no APAP) to subtract solvent effects.
0.1% v/v is at the recommended ceiling for primary cells (e.g., primary human hepatocytes); consider a more concentrated stock or lower dose for extra margin.
Verify the 500 mM stock is fully dissolved in DMSO before dilution.
